messages:
Mia: quick heads-up before I sign off — customer `firefly` is running a short load test at 02:30 UTC, forecasted GPU pool spike to ~82% for ~12m. please watch burst headroom.
AJ: noted. which pool is targeted? alpha-rt or shared-batch?
Mia: alpha-rt primary, fallback to ded-b if alpha saturates. autoscaler should add 2 nodes at ~75% but last time it lagged ~90s.
Samir: FYI current burst_limit for alpha-rt is 12 concurrent jobs, we’re at 7 right now. if we hit 12 new requests they’ll queue — recommend a temporary bump to 18 to pre-warm.
Taylor: I can bump burst_limit for a short window. want me to do it now?
Mia: please yes. also create a short alert for queue_depth > 5 to eng-oncall.
Taylor: doing it — updating policy now.
ops-bot: policy updated: alpha-rt burst_limit set to 18 by Taylor at 2026-03-17T01:05:20Z
Lee: re: autoscaler lag — quick check I run if things look stuck: `kubectl get hpa -n serving alpha-rt-hpa -o yaml | grep -E "minReplicas|maxReplicas|targetCPU"` — runs in the shell and shows desired vs current.
Mia: thanks. I'll hand off to Samir at 02:10 UTC — Samir will take watch through 04:30. Samir?
Samir: I got it. I'll monitor dashboards + queue, and will trigger manual scale if autoscaler drops behind.
AJ: if Samir needs backup ping me, I'll be on standby.
Mia: checklist: bump done, alert created, fallback pool routing notified. remaining ask: Samir please confirm at ~02:12 that pre-warm nodes are online and pool util is back under control.
Samir: will confirm. :thumbsup:
Taylor: small note — updated canary routing threshold to 70% so non-critical traffic routes to ded-b sooner during the spike.
Mia: perfect. leaving now. thanks everyone. :wave:
Samir: confirmed at 02:12 UTC — +2 nodes active, pool util at 64% after pre-warm. monitoring traces and queue depth.
AJ: great, marking this handoff covered.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: eng-oncall check-in at 02:45 UTC
